src=Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/test/OpenEXRTest/comp_dwaa_v1.exr')

print('RC',res.returncode)
print(res.stdout)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
POC="${1:-}"
ANALYSIS="${2:-}"
if [[ -z "$POC" || -z "$ANALYSIS" ]]; then
  echo "usage: $0 <poc> <analysis.json>" >&2
  exit 2
fi
if [[ ! -f "$POC" || ! -f "$ANALYSIS" ]]; then
  echo "missing poc or analysis" >&2
  exit 2
